newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ASX substantial shareholding notices - April 11.
newsitem.headline: ASX substantial shareholding notices - April 11.

text.p: The following substantial shareholder notices have been made to The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).

Macquarie Bank Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Stadium Australia Group SAX.AX on 08/04/1997 with a relevant interest in 23,705,000 ordinary Gold Stapled Securities (68.91%) and 48,000 fully paid ordinary Platinum Stapled Securities (4%).
N.M. Rothschild & Sons (Australia) Pty Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Toll Holdings Limited on 10/04/1997.
Downer Group Australia Pty Ltd increased its relevant interest in Century Drilling Limited on 10/04/1997, from 21,621,538 ordinary shares (39.59%) to 24,189,138 ordinary shares (44.29%).
Alavale Pty Ltd (Roberts Family A/c) ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Cornwall Resource Corporation NL on 07/02/1997.
Bankers Trust Australia Ltd decreased its relevant interest in Jupiters Limited on 28/02/1997, from 18,919,018 ordinary shares (7.83%) to 15,236,648 ordinary shares (6.31%).
Scarborough Pier Pty Ltd & Joshua Ehrlich ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Duketon Goldfields NL on 09/04/1997.
Bankers Trust Australia Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Futuris Corporation Limited on 07/04/1997.
Permanent Trustee Company Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Qni Limited in March 1997.
Permanent Trustee Company Limited decreased its relevant interest in Hawker Richardson Limited on 11/04/1997, from 6,389,048 ordinary shares (17.21%) to 4,764,897 ordinary shares (12.59%).

The Union Gold Mining Company Holdings (NZ) Ltd decreased its relevant interest in Macraes Mining Company Limited on 07/04/1997, from 48,435,874 ordinary shares (38.22%) to 47,257,954 ordinary shares (37.29%).

ABN AMRO AUSTRALIA LIMITED became a substantial shareholder in Stadium Australia Group SAX.AX on 08/04/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 23,475,000* ordinary shares (69.69%).

ABN Amro Australia Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Stadium Australia Group SAX.AX on 08/04/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 23,475,000 ordinary shares* (69.69%).
* 23,457,000 fully paid ordinary shares to be quoted on ASX as SAXA ("Gold Shares"); 18,000 fully paid ordinary shares to be quoted on ASX as SAXE ("Platinum Shares").
GE Capital International Holdings Corporation decreased its relevant interest in Loscam Limited on 20/03/1997, from 108,313,509 ordinary shares (85.99%) to 102,954,909 ordinary shares (81.74%).
